## A reusable candidate template

Copy these five lines for each of three to five candidates. Use your own observations. Put `?` at the end of any statement you are unsure about.

- **Right now:** How it works today.
- **It could:** The state you think is possible.
- **The gap costs:** Who is paying, and what it costs them.
- **This has been going on:** Roughly how long.
- **It has not been fixed because:** Your best current guess.

Draft in one document or in the response box. Copy your candidates and uncertainty marks into the Canvas assignment text-entry box and submit there. Keep a copy for the next activity.

parts.markdown:
## How your work is reviewed

| Criterion | Points |
| --- | --- |
| Three to five concrete candidate problems from your own context | 3 |
| Five-field gap descriptions showing current state, possible state, cost, duration, and likely reason the gap persists | 8 |
| Visible uncertainty marks and a clear distinction between observations and guesses | 4 |
| **Total** | **15** |

Your visible thinking and completeness matter more than polished prose or confidence. Marking what you do not know is part of strong work.
